description: The REPOSITORY paragraph with no entry — the paragraph is ISO/IEC 1989:2002's (§2023:12.3.8); X3.23-1985's CONFIGURATION SECTION prints SOURCE-COMPUTER, OBJECT-COMPUTER and SPECIAL-NAMES only (§1985:IV.6.2.3.1). Each entry kind carries its own introduction row (repository-class-2002, repository-function-2002, repository-interface-2002, repository-program-2002, repository-property-2002), so this row names the one shape none of them sees: the header with no entry. Introduction-gated post-bind by VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitRepositoryParagraph. kb/Work PB5167.
